name: Feetech SCS0009
description: Micro TTL serial bus servo with potentiometer feedback and 300° range, used in the Pollen Robotics Amazing Hand.

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: TTL half-duplex serial, 38.4 kbps–1 Mbps, ID 0–253

envelope.axes: x = length across mounting tabs (case alone 23.2–23.3), y = width, z = case height excl. 3.2 mm output spline

features.label: Case size (spec table)
features.value: 23.2 × 12.1 × 25.25 mm; the drawing dimensions the case length as 23.3 mm

features.label: Mounting tabs
features.value: 2 × Ø2 mm holes, 28.5 mm pitch (14.25 mm each side of the case centre); tab length overall 32.5 mm (16.25 + 16.25)

features.label: Tab height
features.value: Tab underside 16.8 mm and tab top 18.4 mm above the case bottom (tab about 1.6 mm thick)

features.label: Output shaft position
features.value: Shaft axis 5.7 mm from the case centre toward one end; 8.55 mm from the nearer tab hole; centred across the width

features.label: Output spline
features.value: 20T, OD 3.95 mm; protrudes 3.2 mm above the top face; overall height incl. spline 28.45 mm

features.label: Horn screw
features.value: M2 (internal thread in the shaft); datasheet lists M2.0 × 4
features.source: datasheet p.4 item 6-13; drawing PNG ('M2内牙')

features.label: Other heights
features.value: 21.45 mm (top of main case section, below the gear cap); secondary boss 2.9 mm high on the top cap

amazon.title: DIYmall SCS0009 6V 2.3kg Serial Bus Servo Metal Gear 300 Degree Core Motor Single Axis TTL Control Servo for Robot Joints DIY Projects

notes: Feetech publishes no 3D CAD: its official wiki (github.com/ftservo/ftservo-wiki, models/sc-0090-c001/manifest.json) marks 'cad' as missing; only the 2D drawing PNG and PDF datasheet (rev A/0, 2020-11-23) exist. Feetech now catalogues SCS0009 as SC-0090-C001 (the product page's PDF is named SC-0090-C001.pdf). Conflicts: the product page's Chinese/English intro says '25T output', but the spec table, datasheet and drawing all say 20T/OD 3.95 mm. The case length is 23.2 mm in the spec table and 23.3 mm on the drawing. The datasheet's sensor row says 330° (potentiometer angle), while the web table gives a 300° running range over 0–1023. The web table says PC case and -15–70 °C; Switch Science's copy lists 4.8–6 V operating voltage, while Feetech's page and PDF give 4–7.4 V. Rated torque: web 0.7 kg·cm, PDF 0.75 kg·cm @ 6 V. The Amazon listing is from DIYmall, not Feetech. An RCmall '(Feetech)' 2-pack is also verified: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWBZ6DNF. Downloaded docs: docs/SCS0009.pdf, docs/drawing.png.
